root.name: Petrov's Defense: Kaufmann Attack
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. Nxe5 d6 4. Nf3 Nxe4 5. c4

overview: After 5.c4 White challenges the e4 knight and takes space, and Black usually retreats with ...Be6 or ...Be7. White builds with d4 and Nc3 while Black stays solid and tries to equalise. The game is steady with White enjoying a small space edge.

white_ideas.idea: Take space with c4 and d4
Use Nc3 and Be2 to build pressure

black_ideas.idea: Support the knight with ...Be7 and retreat

typical_structures.structure: White pawn centre on c4 and d4 against a solid Black set-up

character.notes: A solid version of the Petrov.

structure.notes: The centre stays flexible with c4 and d4 for White.

character.reason: The Petrov is solid and this branch is steady.

structure.reason: Quiet play with tension in the centre.
